reviews.review:
Warframe is a fast paced 3rd person action shooter. Besides general gunplay the game also offers a melee system with combo chains similar to fighting games like Street Fighter, although not as indepth. You generally parkour around in a randomly generated level while doing the assigned missions and collect loot.

Your homebase is a small spaceship where you can relax, chat with other people or customise your warframe. Warframes are exo skeletons and are similar to MOBA heros. Each warframe has 4 different skills that make them distrinct from one another. 

For example there is Rhino a pretty tough tank-like warframe. He can cover his skin with thick metal plating rendering him invincible until the armor is shot off. Or he can charge at enemies and knock them over.

Every warframe has a unique feel to them and requires different tactics. 

The customisation element plays a huge role in warframe. During your missions you can find mods or ressources. Mods can be used to enhance your warframe or your weapons. You can let your warframe sprint faster or make him able to withstand more punishment. You can add elemental damage to your weapon to burn one foe or electrocute another. Ressources are used to build weapons and warframes. 

Missions are tied to planets. Once you unlock a planet by defeating a boss on another one, you gain access to the planets specific missions. From there your main target is to work your way to the next boss. 

There are many mission types ranging from simple Kill-all-the-enemies missions to survival missions where one must try to hold out as long as he can or rescue missions wher you have to save a POW from execution.

Overall this game offers alot of diverse gameplay and fans of Hack'n Slash games should give it a try.

There are a lot of things I haven't covered such as:

Housing - you can build your own clan dojo
Pets - you can have robotic drones or space dogs which you can breed accompany you during missions
Events and Alerts - which will yield special items and keep the game fresh
Graphics - they are very good for a Freemium game

The game can be played solo vs the AI, coop vs the AI (main focus) or player versus player.

This is a typical Freemium game. You can spend real life currency to obtain things at a much faster rate than players not spending money on it - however you can obtain everything ingame without paying even once.

I am a pretty avid gamer and I have tested and played alot of games now and I think warframe has certainly a lot of potential. Because 1.) it gets constantly updated and 2.) it is a lot of fun to play. You have the thrill for the loot, you constantly try to improve your warframe and on top of that you have a very reasonable community to play with. It may be the nature of a coop game to spawn friendly communities but I have yet to experience an unpleasant run in my 130 hours + of gameplay.

My personal rating for this game would be a 8 out of 10 because it still suffers from bugs that sometimes force you to relog or other minor things such as connection issues from time to time and delayed updating of mods and foundry projects.

Have fun and maybe we will see each other ingame working together to get the big loot!
A cool game if you like guns and gibs
